title: U.S. goods imports, exports and balance by country or area
notes: Goods only, Census basis, not seasonally adjusted. Country/area codes retained as text. Country groups overlap member countries and must not be summed together. Source IYR/EYR annual columns omitted to avoid double counting. Balance is exports minus imports using decimal arithmetic; raw workbook retained. All-zero future months after 2026-09-01 excluded; latest populated source month cross-checked against Census/BEA BOPTEXP.

title: Quarter-end estimated Treasury ownership, backfilled from official archived bulletins
notes: OFS-2 from official Mar-2017, Sep-2017, Dec-2021 and Sep-2026 bulletins; newest available publication among these snapshots wins each overlapping quarter. This is the published mixed-vintage history, not a reconstructed uniform vintage. Source PDF/page/month included per row. Original N/A or dash becomes blank, never inferred zero; source tokens retained. Fed AND government accounts are combined in this table. Privately held includes foreign investors. Private pensions include TSP G Fund; mutual funds include money market and closed-end funds. Insurance revisions described in saved footnotes. 0 component differences exceed rounding tolerance; see saved reconciliation report.

title: Estimated ownership of Treasury securities, all available machine-readable publications
frequency: Quarterly publications, mixed month-end observation dates
notes: record_date is publication date; observation_date/end_of_month is the holding date. Raw source zeros preserved. Treasury documents zeros before March 2024 as unavailable; usable value is blank for those rows. API history begins in 2021 and is not a complete 20-year monthly history. Do not combine multiple publications of the same observation without choosing the latest.
